sources.quote: From here all screens have step-free access, as does our accessible bathroom.

alt_accessible_entrance.note: Silver doors left of the Mecca entrance on Level 3; ring the doorbell

sources.quote: On leaving the lift, take a sharp left and you'll find a silver set of doors to the left of the Mecca entrance.
Ring the black doorbell and a member of Lumiere staff will let you in.

lift.note: The shopping centre's lifts to Level 3

sources.quote: For those visitors who require step-free access to the cinema, this is available via the Mercury Shopping Centre lifts on Level 1 (outside the public WCs) or Level 2 (outside Poundland).

notes: The page says all screens have step-free access from the step-free entrance, but doesn't name the screens or say whether they have wheelchair spaces.

step_free_access.note: A step-free entrance on Level 3 of the Mercury Shopping Centre

sources.quote: On entering the Mercury, take the glass elevators to Level 3 where there is a step-free entrance to the cinema
